title: Bangladesh to adopt April-March fiscal year from FY 2028-29
summary:
Bangladesh’s cabinet has approved a shift in the fiscal year to April 1-March 31 from FY 2028-29, replacing the current July 1-June 30 cycle.
FY 2027-28 will be a nine-month transition ending in March, placing manufacturers, exporters and importers under a changed budget calendar.
The Cabinet Division said the change is intended to help finish infrastructure work before the monsoon.

title: Autumn orders could decide the next move in China FDY prices
summary:

FDY 75D/36F gained 0.28 per cent to 8,975 CNY/mt, while coarser FDY 100D/72F held at 8,750 CNY/mt through the week.
The move was cost-supported rather than demand-led, putting margins, inventory decisions and sourcing plans in focus.

title: India’s growth remains resilient; Q1 GDP seen at 7.3%: Report
summary:

title: Philippines’ T&A imports down but exports strengthen in H1, 2026
summary:

Exports rose 7.22 per cent to $499.93 million, supported by a 19.25 per cent gain in textile yarn and fabric shipments.

title: China’s industrial output, foreign trade grow strongly in 7 months
summary:
China’s industrial output rose 5.3 per cent year on year in the first seven months of 2026, led by high-tech and equipment manufacturing. 
Foreign trade increased 17.3 per cent, with exports up 14.0 per cent and imports 22.0 per cent. 
Trade with Belt and Road partners and private enterprises also recorded sturdy growth, underscoring resilient economic momentum.

title: UK's clothing exports dip 9.8% in June 2026
summary:

In Q2 2026, clothing exports eased 1.93 per cent to £711 million, while fabric exports fell 7.56 per cent to £648 million.
